note: Both sets cover essentially the same claims with the same five duplicated pairs (steel density, Young's modulus, shear modulus, soil shear modulus, soil Poisson's ratio), and all values, bindings and quotes are supported by the text and Table 4-1. Set A additionally records the condition 'Tower material' on three steel property claims, which is supported by the table title 'Material Properties for the Tower', giving it slightly more faithful context. Neither set misreads or invents anything; the only weakness in both is redundancy from repeated claims.
